title: Enchanted PvP
description: This project is a compilation of mods and resource packs that I use in PVP. This will not get you banned, and if it does, notify me, and I'll fix it.
body:
Welcome to the optimized, high-performance modpack built for an amazing experience with vanilla PvP.
No clunky mechanics, no unfair advantages that get you banned, amazing optimization, and the perfect environment to destroy your opponents.
🚀 Key Features
Built for 1v1 Duels: Optimized specifically for fights, practice the techniques you want to learn, and climb the ranks with zero distractions.
Maximum Frames Per Second (FPS): Packed with the latest lightweight optimization mods to keep your performance high, keep low input lag, and maximum frame rates during intense fights.
Clean & Competitive UI: HUD adjustments and visual enhancements keep your eyes on the enemy, not on screen clutter.
🏆 Why Choose This Pack?
This pack was built for the best experience. Whether you are practicing Vanilla, Mace, Sword, or just grinding daily to improve your skill, this modpack gives you the competitive edge without compromising the classic Minecraft feel. If you want to help out, please subscribe to my YouTube channel, Fire-Dog19.
